# Inputs from the negative corpora that detect_sqli is allowed to flag.
# Each one is a known limitation; the corpus test fails if an entry here
# stops being one, so the list stays honest. Lines are read like the
# corpora: trailing whitespace trimmed, then URL-decoded.

# libinjection's own false-positive list; it flags 21 of these, we flag the
# ones below. Each is either runnable SQL (`select x from y where`), an
# operator quoted between two strings, which MySQL evaluates, or arithmetic
# that folds to an attack shape (`80% ACRYLIC AND 20% WOOL`).
